title: drupilot fixpoint record (fixpoint.json)
description: The fixpoint gate's result (scripts/analysis/fixpoint.sh, AR-16, DET-8), in the subject's hidden state dir: after the extraction ran again, what Rector, the codemods and the processed lanes still have to do. converged is true only when the three lists are empty and every tool gave a verdict.

no_verdict.description: True when Rector, PHPStan or a scan feeding the codemod lane (port-safety, signatures, metadata) gave no verdict: the gate cannot converge.

no_verdict_tools.description: The tools that gave no verdict (findings.json .tools), or extraction when extract.sh itself gave none. Absent before 1.0.0-rc.1.

accepted_reverts.description: The deliberate reverts the decision log records (log-decision.sh --kind rector-revert): the Rector findings, codemods and open items they cover, which never block, and the entries that cover nothing on this tree (unmatched). Absent before 1.0.0-rc.1.

rector.description: The Rector findings still there (the official dry-run: the digests rules never count).

codemods.description: The codemods that would still change a file (apply-recipes.sh --dry-run: would-apply).

open_items.description: The open worklist items of a processed lane.
